summary.goal: Automatically create relay channels for new plans when POST /api/plans is called, ensuring new plans immediately have messaging capability without requiring server restart
summary.context: Currently, relay channels for plans are only created at server startup via syncPlanChannels(). When a new plan is created via POST /api/plans, no channel is created. Users must restart the server for the new plan to get a messaging channel. This breaks the real-time messaging experience and makes new plans appear without chat capability until server restart.
in_scope: Hook createPlanChannel into plan creation flow
Handle graceful degradation when relay not connected
Ensure PlannerLead auto-joins new plan channels
out_of_scope: Channel deletion on plan deletion (optional cleanup, separate feature)
Frontend channel discovery (already handles this via API)

acceptance_criteria.description: When POST /api/plans creates a plan, createPlanChannel(planId) is called
New plan channels are created even if relay was connected after server started
If relay is not connected, plan creation still succeeds (graceful degradation)
PlannerLead agent auto-joins newly created plan channels
GET /api/channels returns the new plan channel immediately after plan creation
Channel creation is logged for debugging

observations: Planner package (packages/planner) is designed to be standalone with no relay dependency
Server package (packages/server) has relay integration but mounts planner as a plugin
createPlanChannel exists in packages/server/src/relay/channels.ts but is not called from plan creation
syncPlanChannels at startup syncs existing plans but misses newly created ones
The plan handlers in packages/planner/src/api/handlers/plans.ts have no knowledge of relay
Need a hook/callback mechanism or middleware to bridge planner events to server relay layer
questions: Should this be a middleware that wraps the plan creation endpoint?
Should planner package emit events that server can subscribe to?
Should server override/wrap the plan creation handler directly?
concerns: Coupling between planner (standalone) and server (relay-aware) packages
Error in channel creation should not fail plan creation
Need to ensure PlannerLead joins before messages can be sent

architect.rationale: Keeps planner package standalone while allowing server to hook into plan creation events
architect.alternative_considered: Event emitter in planner package - rejected because it adds relay awareness to standalone package

steps.title: Create plan creation middleware
steps.description: Create middleware in packages/server/src/relay/plan-channel-middleware.ts that intercepts POST /api/plans responses and calls createPlanChannel when a plan is successfully created. The middleware should wrap the response to extract the plan_id from successful responses.

acceptance_criteria.description: Middleware exports planChannelMiddleware function
Middleware only acts on POST /api/plans requests
Middleware calls createPlanChannel after successful (201) response
Middleware passes through response unchanged to client
Errors in channel creation are logged but do not affect response

steps.title: Mount middleware in server
steps.description: Add the planChannelMiddleware to the Express app in packages/server/src/server.ts before the planner router is mounted. This ensures the middleware can intercept plan creation responses.

acceptance_criteria.description: Middleware is imported in server.ts
Middleware is mounted before planner router
Server starts successfully with middleware

steps.title: Add PlannerLead auto-join for new channels
steps.description: Update createPlanChannel in channels.ts to notify PlannerLead to join the new channel. This can be done by calling a function exported from planner-lead.ts or by having PlannerLead subscribe to channel creation events.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlannerLead joins new plan channels when they are created
If PlannerLead is not running, channel is still created
Join is logged for debugging

architecture.integration: createPlanChannel calls plannerLead.joinChannel or emits event

steps.title: Add integration tests
steps.description: Create tests in packages/server/src/relay/plan-channel-middleware.test.ts that verify: (1) channel is created when plan is created, (2) graceful degradation when relay disconnected, (3) PlannerLead joins new channels.

acceptance_criteria.description: Test: POST /api/plans creates plan channel
Test: Plan creation succeeds even if relay disconnected
Test: PlannerLead is notified of new channel
All tests pass with npm test

cases.description: POST /api/plans creates plan channel when relay connected
PlannerLead auto-joins newly created plan channel
GET /api/channels includes new plan channel immediately after creation
Messages can be sent to new plan channel without server restart
Plan creation succeeds when relay not connected (graceful degradation)
Channel is created when relay reconnects after plan was created while disconnected
Duplicate channel creation is handled gracefully (idempotent)
Error in createPlanChannel does not fail plan creation
Error in PlannerLead join does not fail channel creation

data_requirements: Test relay daemon or mock relay client
